stories.summary: Control of Congress and the fate of President Trump's legislative agenda are now in the hands of American voters, who are heading to the polls to decide the 2026 midterm elections. Here’s how to follow our news coverage, with real-time results, visuals and analysis from more than 400 journalists.

stories.title: Gas prices reach record high for an Election Day
stories.titleEn: Gas prices reach record high for an Election Day
stories.summary: Gas prices today are at a record high for Election Day in recorded history, hovering at an average of $4.11 a gallon nationally as of Tuesday afternoon, according to GasBuddy. The previous record for Election Day gas prices was set in 2022, with an average of around $3.75 per gallon, U.S. government data shows.
